note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CYP 111(B); A06b CYP 111 (B); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 8 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Cyprus, 2024
sources.said: Person was resident in Cyprus for a total period of 8 years within a period of 11 years, of which the year immediately prior to the submission of the application must be continuous (with 90 days of absence allowed). By way of exception, certain categories of persons (e.g. domestic workers, students) must have been resident in Cyprus for a total period of 7 years before the submission of the application, of which the last 12 months should be continuous. Person must have intention to remain in Cyprus or at service of Cyprus. ... n.a. ... n.a.
